status: Repository foundation scaffold and automated ChatJS module archive in place; feature implementation has not started.
runtimePolicy: Track the current supported Node.js LTS runtime in CI; do not maintain a ChatJS product release or versioning system.
distributionArchive: dist/ChatJS.tar.gz (generated by npm run archive and uploaded by successful CI runs)
completed: Established the public GitHub repository codexclai/ChatJS as the project workspace.
Created conventional Node.js source, types, tests, scripts, and GitHub automation structure.
Established ChatJS-named CommonJS and ESM entry points and TypeScript declarations.
Added a minimal client lifecycle foundation and built-in Node.js test coverage.
Added /docs as shared AI memory, knowledge base, task list, history, decisions, experiments, open questions, and project handbook.
Added root-level ChatJS.md as canonical end-user/API documentation, separate from /docs.
Added a dependency-free ChatJS.tar.gz builder, archive integrity test, CI extraction/load smoke tests, and workflow artifact delivery.

Recorded the user's confirmation that ChatGPT.zip in ChatJS Project → Sources is their latest Google Play APK at acquisition time; the source remains in Project Sources and is not copied into the public repository.
Removed ChatJS product version numbering, package version fields, lockfiles, release workflows, checksum inventories, and npm registry publishing.
notImplemented: ChatGPT authentication, account/session management, or service transport.
Conversation, message, streaming, model, tool, multimodal, voice, memory, project, GPT, or settings features.
A verified 1:1 ChatGPT mobile feature inventory or compatibility guarantee.
Runtime integrations with official, documented, or otherwise authorized service interfaces.
nextActions: Apply the manual GitHub repository description, topics, main-branch protection, and security settings in docs/REPOSITORY_SETTINGS.md.
Confirm the legal rights holder and obtain legal review of the proprietary all-rights-reserved notice before accepting external code contributions.
Define a source-backed ChatGPT capability inventory using official sources and observations from ChatGPT.zip in ChatJS Project → Sources.
Design and test the first stable client, transport, event, streaming, cancellation, and error contracts before implementing capabilities.

reference.source: ChatGPT.zip in ChatJS Project → Sources in ChatGPT
reference.acquisition: The user reports that the APK was exported immediately after updating ChatGPT from Google Play and is the latest build available to them at acquisition time.
reference.availability: The APK is stored in ChatJS Project Sources, not GitHub. New chats must search Project Sources before asking the user to reattach it.
reference.evidenceLimit: The user-provided Google Play acquisition provenance is recorded. Future chats must inspect the actual source file when available and must not claim inspection if it is inaccessible.
